checks.checks: No later than fixes latest Friday-afternoon deadline and permits earlier. Alternatives fail comparative/polarity; Chinese rationale must not imply strictly before Friday afternoon.

activeQuestion.prompt: To avoid delays, submit the purchase request ____ than Friday afternoon.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 為避免延誤，請____星期五下午提交採購申請。

options.whyZh: than 之前需比較級 later。
no later than Friday afternoon 表示最遲在星期五下午提交，也可以更早；並不排除星期五下午本身。
最高級 latest 不與 than 搭配。
lately 表示最近，不是截止時刻。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: no later than Friday afternoon 表示最遲在星期五下午提交，也可以更早；並不排除星期五下午本身。
activeQuestion.evidence: To avoid delays, submit the purchase request no later than Friday afternoon.
